value.rationale: The image-of-differentials value semimodule is a classical analytic invariant that can distinguish singularity strata invisible to their common numerical semigroup. Computing it for all multiplicity-five unimodal space-curve types is a natural finite complete classification motivated by a new exhaustive family, not an artificial parameter slice. The explicit b=13/12 jump is a genuine geometric boundary and the finite colengths are exact invariants. The theorem does not claim to classify arbitrary analytic types or derive a general new algorithm.
